@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible import context
+from ansible.cli.galaxy import GalaxyCLI
+from ansible.galaxy.role import GalaxyRole
+from ansible.utils import context_objects as co
+from ansible.utils.display import Display
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def reset_cli_args():
+    co.GlobalCLIArgs._Singleton__instance = None
+    yield
+    co.GlobalCLIArgs._Singleton__instance = None
+
+
+def test_implicit_install_processes_roles_and_collections(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    """Dropping collection dispatch must fail this test."""
+    requirements = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements.write_text('roles:\n- name: example.role\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+    installed_roles = []
+    installed_collections = []
+
+    def install_role(self):
+        installed_roles.append(self.name)
+        return True
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyRole, 'install', install_role)
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections',
+                        lambda requirements, path, *args: installed_collections.append((requirements, path)))
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.validate_collection_path',
+                        lambda path: os.path.join(str(tmp_path), 'ansible_collections'))
+
+    cli = GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', str(requirements), '--no-deps'])
+    cli.run()
+
+    assert installed_roles == ['example.role']
+    assert installed_collections[0][0] == [('example.collection', '*', None)]
+    assert 'Starting galaxy role install process' in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_implicit_custom_role_path_skips_collections_with_warning(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Installing collections despite a roles path must fail this test."""
+    requirements = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements.write_text('roles: []\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+    installed = []
+    warnings = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', lambda *args: installed.append(args))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Display, 'warning', lambda self, message: warnings.append(message))
+
+    GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', str(requirements), '-p', str(tmp_path)]).run()
+
+    assert installed == []
+    assert any('collections' in warning.lower() for warning in warnings)
+
+
+def test_implicit_install_parser_has_requirements_key():
+    """Removing the shared requirements default must fail this test."""
+    GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'install']).parse()
+    assert context.CLIARGS['requirements'] is None
+
+
+def test_empty_requirements_file_skips_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    """Rejecting an empty file instead of skipping it must fail this test."""
+    requirements = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements.write_text('')
+    installed = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr('ansible.cli.galaxy.install_collections', lambda *args: installed.append(args))
+
+    GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', str(requirements)]).run()
+
+    assert installed == []
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_explicit_role_install_reports_ignored_collections(tmp_path, capsys):
+    """Calling present collections 'no requirements' must fail this test."""
+    requirements = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements.write_text('roles: []\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+
+    GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'role', 'install', '-r', str(requirements)]).run()
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert 'collections which will be ignored' in output
+    assert 'ansible-galaxy collection install -r' in output
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' not in output
